# messages_prefix_reuse
# the same request twice on one server: the record is the second, which reuses the first's prefix
# normalized: ids
POST /v1/messages
{"model":"tiny","max_tokens":4,"temperature":0,"logit_bias":{"66":100},"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}

HTTP 200
Content-Type: application/json

{"content":[{"text":"aaaa","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_<1>","model":"tiny","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"max_tokens","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"cache_read_input_tokens":19,"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":4}}
